g.aria-label: Calibrated Pairing Divergence d_Rp(p, q) = sup_D Φ(D) + log 2
d_Rp(p, q) = JS(p ⊗ q, q ⊗ p)
Equals H(½(p⊗q + q⊗p)) − H(p) − H(q) ≥ 0, vanishing iff q = p
Evaluated at optimal difference D*(x) − D*(x') = λ(x) − λ(x')
d_Rp(p, q) = I((a₁, a₂); y) = log 2 − H(y | a₁, a₂)
Mutual information (nats) that an ordered pair carries about y
